description: Scenario coverage ledger for scripts/verify/scenarios. A registered tool must either appear in a scenario step or carry an explicit waiver with a reason. 'covered' is not listed here: it is derived from the scenarios themselves, so a deleted scenario cannot leave a stale claim behind. tests/unit/verify-scenario-coverage.test.ts enforces both directions.

waived.file_organizer_analyze_duplicates: duplicate deep-analysis; covered once find_duplicate_files joins a dedicated duplicates scenario
waived.file_organizer_batch_read_files: reader batching over multiple paths; needs a multi-file fixture policy decision
waived.file_organizer_batch_rename: writes many files with a collision matrix; scenario waits on a seeded rename fixture
waived.file_organizer_delete_duplicates: destructive deletion; scenario must first prove preview_delete_duplicates
waived.file_organizer_disk_usage_by_category: report-only aggregation; no state to prove beyond isError
waived.file_organizer_export_config: writes a config report to a user-chosen path; report-path sandbox policy not settled
waived.file_organizer_export_report: same report-path policy as export_config (see AGENTS.md rule 3 leak classes)
waived.file_organizer_find_broken_symlinks: needs seeded broken symlinks, which the fixtures do not create
waived.file_organizer_find_empty_directories: seeded tree has no empty directories, so the scenario could only assert the vacuous zero
waived.file_organizer_find_largest_files: report-only aggregation; no state to prove beyond isError
waived.file_organizer_inspect_metadata: EXIF fixtures are unit-test territory; the seeded sandbox has no real JPEG EXIF
waived.file_organizer_organize_by_date: requires two non-nested allowed directories (see skill Coverage section); sandbox layout change pending
waived.file_organizer_organize_by_project: project detection needs recognizable project markers not in the fixtures
waived.file_organizer_organize_music: music metadata organizer; seeded fixtures have no audio files
waived.file_organizer_organize_photos: photo organizer; seeded fixtures have no real image metadata
waived.file_organizer_organizer_digest: digest aggregates history; needs a settled history shape to assert on
waived.file_organizer_preview_delete_duplicates: destructive-family preview; pairs with delete_duplicates scenario
waived.file_organizer_quarantine_files: moves files into quarantine storage; rollback of quarantine needs a fixture decision
waived.file_organizer_restore_quarantine: requires quarantine_files to have run first
waived.file_organizer_search_history: searches operations.jsonl written by organize; joins the next organize-scenario pass
waived.file_organizer_sensitive_scan: analyzes only JPEG/TIFF; reports skipped on default fixtures (skill Coverage section)
waived.file_organizer_set_custom_rules: replaces persisted custom rules; needs a rules fixture and restore story
waived.file_organizer_smart_suggest: suggestion engine output is advisory; no stable contract to assert yet
waived.file_organizer_system_organize: organizes well-known system folders; intentionally refuses sandbox roots
waived.file_organizer_find_old_files: report-only aggregation; age filtering is pinned by unit tests
